278073388.description: This collection includes a variety of rocks, minerals, fossils, and tumbled gemstones in multiple colors such as purple, yellow, white, green, blue, and brown. Among the specimens are rough minerals like quartz and possibly calcite geodes, along with fossilized coral and a fossil featuring a visible trilobite imprint. The assortment contains both natural and polished stones, including a labeled Labradorite specimen. All pieces are in good condition with no visible damage, and the lot features a range of sizes and shapes.

278072320.description: This is a vintage handmade African tribal percussion instrument, specifically a rattle or shaker. It features a double-triangle or hourglass-shaped wooden frame constructed from natural branches. Several metal discs or washers are attached with natural wire, producing sound when shaken. The frame is decorated with raw quartz crystals affixed by wire. The instrument measures approximately 15 inches in height. It shows signs of use and age, including wear on the wood and metal parts, contributing to its rustic and authentic appearance. This item can be used as a functional musical instrument or as a unique decorative or collectible piece. Please review all photos carefully, as they are considered part of the item description. Vintage and collectible items may show wear, discoloration, scratches, crazing, repairs, age-related deterioration, or other imperfections consistent with age and use. Due to the nature of donated goods, we cannot guarantee age, rarity, authenticity, manufacturer attribution, production dates, or collectible value unless specifically stated in the listing. Please ask any questions prior to bidding.

277935339.description: Pair of natural agate geode bookends. Left piece features vibrant blue crystalline formations with concentric banding and a polished face. Right piece displays orange, brown, and black banded agate with a polished face. Both have rough natural stone exteriors and are cut flat on one side for stability as bookends. Medium-sized with visible mineral and crystal details typical of agate geodes. Good used condition. No brand or manufacturer markings. Agate ranks at 6.5 to 7 on the Mohs hardness scale, meaning it’s very durable. You likely won’t have to worry about it being damaged much.
